newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian papers condemn Israel over Lebanon attacks.
newsitem.headline: Syrian papers condemn Israel over Lebanon attacks.

text.p: Syrian newspapers on Sunday accused Israel of attacking civilians in Lebanon and starving Palestinians under the pretext of security.
They also said U.S. envoy Dennis Ross's current mission would not succeed if Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu did not change his policies.

"Success in defusing the heightened tension and alleviating the boiling situation which is prevailing in the region because of Israel's political and military escalations and settlements...and optimism to get over the tragic situation...are faint hopes," al-Thawra daily said.

"Efforts should focus on solving the roots and real causes of the struggle...the factors which led to the recent Jerusalem bombing...the anger, dismay, depression, lack of trust and oppression which the Palestinians feel because of the Israeli policies," it said.

"Netanyahu's government, under security pretexts, launches daily malicious aggressions on south Lebanon and commits massacres against innocent civilians...and under the same pretext continues for the 11th day a starvation siege against more than two million Palestinians," al-Thawra said.
The newspapers urged Washington to put pressure on Israel to change policies.
"It is only just and comprehensive peace that would return Arab lands, end Israeli occupation and provide self-determination for Palestinians....," the official daily Tishreen said.
"No matter what developed weapons Israel owns, it would not be able to impose peace according to its own understanding...the absence of peace means the absence of security," al-Thawra said.

"It is necessary that the international society and especially the American sponsor take proper measures to curb this government...and make it understand that security cannot be achieved by aggression against others' rights and security."
